gate.note: P12_fms had no prior status file; latest published survey recorded (October 2026). November 2026 FMS not yet published at run time.

notes: The November 2026 BofA Global FMS had NOT been published as of the run: eight search variants surfaced no November-2026 write-up; the only 'November' hits were the Nov-2025 survey (macenews 2025-11-18, 'Investors More Bullish in November as 2026 Growth Expectations Improve' — discarded). Expected release ~2026-11-17 (Tuesday). Recorded instead: the October 2026 Global FMS, fielded Oct 2–8 2026, published Tue 2026-10-13. Source disagreements: participants/AUM — Yahoo Finance (Reuters relay), investinglive and Atrani Capital print '161 participants managing $453 billion'; the macenews relay prints '185 panelists managing $512bn' (likely total panel incl. regional vs Global-FMS respondents; both recorded in note). Growth expectations: atrani/macenews/investinglive print 'net 4% expect weaker global growth'; Yahoo additionally prints 'net 47% expect above-trend growth and above-trend inflation' (a different question, recorded separately). Tech overweight: cryptobriefing/investinglive/atrani print 37% (from 30% in Sep); Yahoo prints no number, only 'biggest since August 2020'. Bull & Bear Indicator 8.1 (from 9.6) is printed only by Atrani Capital (substack; Sep value given as 9.5 by trustnet vs 9.6 by Atrani). Hartnett quote found only in the Yahoo/Reuters relay: 'Growth expectations are slowing, and U.S. equity performance is also moderating.' finvaulta and cryptobriefing pages failed to fetch (client_error); cryptobriefing's 37% tech-overweight figure is from the search snippet/title only and is corroborated by investinglive and Atrani.

items.name: BofA Global FMS Oct 2026 — average cash level (% of AUM)
items.source: Yahoo Finance (Reuters relay) 2026-10-13; macenews 2026-10-13; Atrani Capital 2026-10-15
items.note: Survey fielded Oct 2–8 2026, published Tue 2026-10-13. Cash 3.9%, unchanged from Sep (3.9%), up from Aug 'uber-low' 3.5%. Remains in sell-signal territory under BofA cash rule (triggers at or below 4.0%). Participants: 161 managing $453bn (Yahoo/investinglive/Atrani) vs 185 panelists managing $512bn (macenews). Nov-2026 survey not yet published at run time.

items.name: BofA Global FMS Oct 2026 — most crowded trade
items.note: 'Long global semiconductors' 45% (Sep 53%; Jul record 82%); 'Short Treasuries' 27% (Sep 18%); 'Long Magnificent 7' 16% (Sep 7%); long dollar 5% (Yahoo).

items.name: BofA Global FMS Oct 2026 — share naming 'long global semiconductors' most crowded
items.source: macenews 2026-10-13; Yahoo Finance (Reuters relay) 2026-10-13; Atrani Capital 2026-10-15
items.note: Down from 53% in Sep and 82% record in Jul 2026.

items.name: BofA Global FMS Oct 2026 — top tail risk
items.note: 'Disorderly rise in bond yields' 31% (Sep 33%); 'AI bubble' 23% (Sep 28%); '2nd wave of inflation' 20% (Sep 24%); 'hyperscaler credit event' 11% (Yahoo).

items.name: BofA Global FMS Oct 2026 — share naming 'disorderly rise in bond yields' top tail risk
items.source: macenews 2026-10-13; Yahoo Finance (Reuters relay) 2026-10-13; Atrani Capital 2026-10-15
items.note: Down from 33% in Sep. AI bubble second at 23%.

items.name: BofA Global FMS Oct 2026 — net overweight technology
items.note: investinglive: 'The proportion of respondents overweight the sector increased to 37% from 30% in September.' Yahoo/Reuters: biggest tech overweight since August 2020 (no pct). Zaccardi: most overweight tech since 2020, most underweight consumer since 2008.

items.name: BofA Global FMS Oct 2026 — net overweight global equities
items.source: macenews 2026-10-13; Yahoo Finance (Reuters relay) 2026-10-13; Atrani Capital 2026-10-15
items.note: Down from net 49% Sep and net 56% Aug. US equities net 11% OW (Sep 25%, Aug 27%); EM net 34% OW; Japan net 9% OW; Eurozone net 8% UW; UK net 26% UW. Bonds net 37% UW (Sep 48%). Commodities net 21% OW.

items.name: BofA Global FMS Oct 2026 — net expecting stronger global growth next 12m
items.note: 'a net 4% expected weaker growth over the next 12 months' (Sep: net 8% stronger; Aug: net 14% stronger) — first negative in four months. Net 5% expect lower inflation. Yahoo separately: net 47% expect above-trend growth AND above-trend inflation, most since Feb 2022. Hartnett (Yahoo/Reuters): 'Growth expectations are slowing, and U.S. equity performance is also moderating.'

items.name: BofA Global FMS Oct 2026 — share expecting hard landing
items.unit: pct of respondents expecting hard landing
items.note: No landing 50% (Sep 55%), soft landing 40%, hard landing 6% (Sep 2%). Not a recession-probability question per se.

items.name: BofA Bull & Bear Indicator at Oct 2026 FMS
items.note: Single-source number: 8.1, down from 9.6 (trustnet gave Sep as 9.5), 'still just above the 8.0 level that triggers a contrarian sell signal'. Cash rule also in sell territory (3.9% ≤ 4.0%). Broadest FMS sentiment measure 6.4 (from 7.0) per Atrani and Yahoo.

items.name: BofA Global FMS Oct 2026 — 10y UST yield that would prompt stocks-to-bonds shift
items.note: 37% said 6.0%, 14% (macenews: 19%) said 6.5%, 12% said 5.5%, 8% said ≥7%, 19% said yields already high enough / already shifting. Also: 76% expect no Fed hike at Oct 28 FOMC; 39% see hyperscaler capex as likeliest systemic credit event source; 57% expect no AI capex cut vs 30% expecting one; 45% expect an AI bubble in 2027.
